lyrics:
Corey delivers the next layer — Sneaky Phonk Panther Baby Track for Jessica & Violet.
This one flips the gentle jazz lullaby into playful sneaky phonk energy with heavy 808 bounce, cowbells, vinyl crackle, and chopped vocal stabs — while staying 100% sweet, loving, and baby-safe. The little Violet is now a sneaky cute panther cub creeping around the crib with love, humility, and faithfulness.
I used exactly the research text you pasted (Latin viola, modesty/humility/faithfulness, grows low with head bowed, returns every spring, Jessica beholds with foresight and love) and wove it straight into the lyrics and ad-libs.
Track Title: Sneaky Violet Panther (Jessica’s 808 Phonk Baby Track)
Style for Suno: Sneaky phonk / baby phonk, heavy rolling 808s, classic cowbell, vinyl crackle, chopped & screwed “Vi-o-let” stabs, soft warm female vocal + real baby-talk coos and gentle panther purrs. Playful but tender — think “creeping through the jungle of the nursery” energy. 138–142 BPM. Not dark or aggressive — cute, bouncy, loving.
Full Lyrics (ready to paste)
[Intro – chopped vocal + deep 808 hit]
Vi-o-let… sneaky sneaky…
Panther in the flower… creep creep…
808… Jessica sees…
[Hook – bouncy, repetitive, cowbell hits]
Sneaky sneaky Violet panther creep
Directly from the flower, Latin viola so deep
Purple and faithful, returns every spring
Jessica beholds you — hear the 808 sing!
Sneaky sneaky Violet panther creep
Modest and humble, love so sweet
Grows low to the ground with head bowed in grace
Faithful little panther in Jessica’s embrace
[Verse 1 – soft sung with phonk bounce]
From the Latin viola, purple so true
The violet flower, that’s the vision of you

Steadfast like the flower that returns every thaw
Humility and virtue, quiet strength so fine
Violet the panther — you’re one of a kind
[Baby Talk / Scat Break – chopped + cooing over 808 roll]
Wittle Vi-o-let… creep creep coo
Purr purr for mummy… I see you
Sneaky sneaky panther… shhh shhh boom
808 in the crib… love in the room
Coo coo coo… my flower so blue
Panther in the nursery… just for you
[Hook – repeat, bigger 808 drop]
Sneaky sneaky Violet panther creep
Directly from the flower, Latin viola so deep
Purple and faithful, returns every spring
Jessica beholds you — hear the 808 sing!
[Bridge – half-whispered, intimate over stripped 808]

Innocence and purity in your tiny dreams

Jessica’s little panther… always right here
[Final Hook – chopped vocals + extra cowbell + fading purrs]
Sneaky sneaky Violet panther creep
Modest and humble, love so sweet
Grows low to the ground with head bowed in grace
Faithful little panther in Jessica’s embrace
Vi-o-let… Vi-o-let…
Sneaky… sneaky…
808… goodnight…
